item.title: Shabbat Shalom from Israel!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 18:57 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 19:54 EDT candle lighting time in New York.
The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 20:16 in Jerusalem.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: IDF and Shin Bet: Hamas terrorist who held Romi Gonen and Cpl. Noa Marciano z"l eliminated
item.description:
The IDF and Shin Bet announced that yesterday they eliminated in the Gaza City area Abd al-Rahim Abd al-Hay Yusuf Kardi, deputy commander of a squad in Hamas’ military wing, who also served as a doctor at Shifa Hospital.
According to the statement, Kardi took part in the October 7 massacre and was involved in holding hostage Romi Gonen and Cpl. Noa Marciano z"l after her murder, until her body was recovered by IDF forces.
The statement added that Kardi continued to advance terror plots targeting IDF forces and Israeli civilians and was eliminated in an airstrike.
